independence.campaign_boundary: structural CampaignRecordAdapter counts and pending designs

uncertainty.covariance_policy: components combine in quadrature only under the documented zero-covariance assumption; never infer absent covariance
uncertainty.bias_correction: paired additive residual equals highest minus lower

selection.normalization: bounded component scaling followed by utility/(utility+positive equivalent-highest cost), monotonic in utility/cost and finite

uncertainty_signal.combination_order: for each objective, quadrature across epistemic, aleatoric, model-discrepancy spread and estimated-bias standard error before normalization
uncertainty_signal.objective_scale: required positive declared scale when outputs use differing units; defaults to 1
uncertainty_signal.overflow_policy: evaluate the equivalent transform through scaled hypot and log-domain arithmetic

selection.finite_policy: reject nonfinite inputs, overflowed corrected means, components, and final scores before ranking
selection.tie_policy: descending score, descending source rank, ascending source name; independent of input order
selection.highest_fidelity_quota: reserve remaining slots when remaining equals quota deficit
selection.infeasible_quota: reject when remaining slots are less than quota deficit

pending_method.label: asynchronous-posterior-mean-fantasy-approximation
pending_method.claim: deterministic approximation, not exact conditional GP fantasization
pending_method.duplicate_control: radial spatial repulsion around pending designs

robustness.monte_carlo: local deterministic PRNG initialized from required non-negative seed

distribution_adapter.return_contract: one finite non-boolean numbers.Real scalar; validate type before float conversion
distribution_adapter.accepted_types: standard real int/float/Fraction and optional NumPy integer/floating scalars registered with numbers.Real
distribution_adapter.rejected_types: bool and NumPy bool, str, bytes, bytearray, Decimal, complex, containers and objects that only define numeric coercion such as __float__
distribution_adapter.error_policy: missing, inaccessible, non-callable, bad-signature, raised, non-scalar, malformed or nonfinite results become ActiveLearningError
distribution_adapter.seed_policy: all adapters receive only the propagation-local seeded random.Random instance

robustness.cvar: finite-sample empirical expected shortfall with observation mass 1/n and fractional boundary mass; probability is tail mass for both tails and lies in (0,1]

promotion.probability_policy: every marginal must pass; no independence assumption

robustness.promotion_input_policy: validate finite non-empty objective vector, every finite same-sized comparison vector, exact direction labels and finite probabilities before feasibility or dominance logic; an empty comparison set is allowed only after candidate validation

calibration.diagnostic: held-out marginal Gaussian interval coverage within exactly one declared in-domain or ood stratum

integer_contracts.policy: reject booleans, floats including integer-valued floats, and out-of-range integers
